title: The forum-defendant limitation
summary: The forum-defendant rule restricts specified diversity removals when a properly joined and served defendant is a citizen of the forum state. It is a statutory restriction beyond the existence of diversity jurisdiction.
notes: The assigned Lively discussion treats the restriction as procedural for the issue presented. CAFA has different removal provisions, so this limitation should not be transferred to that statute without checking its text.

sections.Meaning: The forum-defendant rule restricts specified diversity removals when a properly joined and served defendant is a citizen of the forum state. It is a statutory restriction beyond the existence of diversity jurisdiction.
sections.How to work through the question: Identify the basis of removal and the citizenship and service status of the relevant defendant. Then distinguish the restriction from an absence of original subject-matter jurisdiction when considering remand timing and preservation.
